description: 서울교통공사_1_8호선 역사 좌표(위경도) 정보 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 서울교통공사. 서울교통공사 1~8호선에 위치한 276개 전 역사의 경위도 좌표 정보는 현재 공사에서 제공하고 있는 공식 자료로, 각 역의 위치가 소수점 여섯째 자리까지 정밀하게 기록되어 있어 다양한 공공 및 민간 활용에 도움이 되는 기본 데이터입니다. 다만 서울교통공사는 철도 노선의 건설이나 정교한 측량과 같은 전문적... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 서울교통공사. Its tags are 서울지하철, 지하철, 1호선에서 8호선, 지하철역, 역사좌표. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
